publications.title: We fixed Impulse!
publications.subtitle: A faster, cleaner and more reliable standalone experience.

sections.title: A completely new interface
sections.body: Impulse Standalone now uses a sharp and responsive native WebView experience built around your servers.

sections.title: More reliable launches
sections.body: Server files are checked, repaired and verified before Minecraft continues loading.

sections.title: Your mods, your way
sections.body: Browse Modrinth and add compatible custom mods directly to each standalone profile.

sections.title: Stronger security checks
sections.body: Impulse uses modern hashes and independent sources to help you understand the files offered by a server.
